findings.observation: The corrected local-link test executes position and interaction-script lookup, but it never calls the collision function whose behavior the candidate changes for remote sources and targets.
findings.impact: The focused suite can pass even if the new GetObjectObjectCollidesWith filtering later makes ordinary link-player ObjectEvents ignore real objects or otherwise changes legacy link collision behavior, leaving the required local-link isolation proof incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Extend the focused local-link regression to call GetObjectObjectCollidesWith with a genuine link-player ObjectEvent, a reserved remote, and an ordinary overlapping object; prove the remote alone is nonblocking while ordinary link-player-to-real-object collision remains unchanged.
evidence: src/event_object_movement.c:6639-6671 changes GetObjectObjectCollidesWith by excluding a collision whenever either the candidate target or moving source is the reserved remote.
test/coop/presence_runtime.c:763-834 exercises GetObjectEventIdByPosition and GetInteractedLinkPlayerScript only; no candidate test calls GetObjectObjectCollidesWith or CheckForObjectEventCollision.

The sealed RPAC3-005 coverage requirement calls for deterministic execution of local-link isolation paths, and the earlier ownership review specifically identified both lookup and collision behavior as affected surfaces.
